system: You triage expense claims. Reply with exactly one word: APPROVE if the claim is within policy and has a receipt, otherwise ESCALATE.

tasks.prompt: Claim: taxi to the airport, 18 USD, receipt attached, within policy (limit 50 USD).
Claim: hotel, 940 USD, no receipt, policy limit 300 USD per night.
Claim: team lunch, 42 USD, receipt attached, within policy (limit 60 USD).
Claim: personal gym membership, 75 USD, not a business expense.
Claim: train ticket, 64 USD, receipt attached, within policy (limit 120 USD).
Claim: laptop, 2400 USD, no purchase approval, policy requires approval above 500 USD.
Claim: parking, 12 USD, receipt attached, within policy (limit 30 USD).
Claim: conference fee, 1200 USD, receipt for a different employee.
